prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational image edit. Edit the attached task infographic preserving its polished cinematic Mars palette, navy background, orange terrain and cyan boxes. Completely replace the original serial task flow and right-hand text. Main title exactly 'When optional sampling becomes eligible'. Use a precise dependency graph with independent gates. A small node 'Discovery' points ONLY to 'Inspection completed'. Four independent gate boxes labeled exactly 'Inspection completed', 'Primary B work completed', 'Capability compatible', 'Work + directed return + reserves fit' must each have an arrow converging on one outcome node labeled exactly 'Eligible optional sample'. Never show stop primary mission, mission completed, guaranteed safe, approved execution, ground truth or sample actually collected. Remove all other paragraphs, legends, status values and numeric claims to keep a simple readable graph. No logos, flags, NASA branding or mission insignia. Large text readable at 900 pixel display width. Full-width dark footer must show exact text in at least 32-pixel font at original scale: 'AI-generated | Conceptual illustration'.

Make one targeted correction to the attached infographic while preserving every current label, title, box, gate independence, source style, geometry and large watermark. Add the exact clearly readable line 'All four conditions must hold' directly above the green horizontal convergence bus, without covering any arrow or node. The phrase must make the four incoming gates an AND requirement. Label each green outgoing gate branch 'Yes' and each red outgoing branch 'No', keeping the red branches connected only to 'Defer optional work'. Do not add any arrow from inspection to primary B, any sequential dependency among the four gates, any completed mission or collected sample status, any safety guarantee, any logo or NASA branding. Preserve the large footer verbatim 'AI-generated | Conceptual illustration'.

Both outcome boxes are terminal: absolutely NO arrows leave either outcome. Absolutely NO line may pass behind, through or across any other box. The red NO arrow originates only at the center diamond and never approaches or passes through the eligibility box. Do not draw individual Yes/No outputs from the four input boxes. Keep large simple readable typography with plenty of whitespace. No other outcomes, safety claims, completion status, numbers, collected-sample scene, logos, flags or NASA branding.
